intervention_description: Participants at the 20-year follow-up with complete data and a 10-year consensus diagnosis of schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder (n=80) or bipolar disorder (n=48); no vocational intervention was delivered by the study
Participants at the 20-year follow-up whose 10-year consensus diagnosis was schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder; no vocational intervention was delivered by the study
Participants at the 20-year follow-up whose 10-year consensus diagnosis was bipolar disorder with psychosis; no vocational intervention was delivered by the study
Therapeutic-community occupational rehabilitation; every resident was allocated at baseline to a hospital-based workshop, sheltered employment or supported employment

headspace Early Psychosis programme: community early-intervention care by a multidisciplinary team, with vocational support and embedded Individual Placement and Support workers as one of 16 core service components, delivered at 15 headspace centres in six clusters

Care as received in Danish child and adolescent psychiatric services; one constituent study (TEA) randomised participants to quetiapine extended release or aripiprazole, and all of its participants are included
